column_description: Unique identifier for each motion path.
ID of the robot associated with the path. may be NULL.
Name of the motion path. may be NULL.
Description of the motion path. may be NULL.
Date the path started. may be NULL.
Date the path ended. may be NULL.
Version of the motion path. may be NULL.
Status of the path (e.g., active, inactive, archived). always exactly one of 'active', 'inactive', 'archived'. may be NULL.
User who created the path. may be NULL.
User who last modified the path. may be NULL.
